function.arguments: {"sql":"SELECT ticker, period_end, value as rd, (SELECT value FROM financials f2 WHERE f2.ticker=financials.ticker AND f2.metric='revenue' AND f2.period_end=financials.period_end) as rev FROM financials WHERE metric='rd_expense' AND ticker IN ('META','GOOGL') ORDER BY period_end DESC LIMIT 10"}
